text: 中国10月新增社融1.15万亿元，人民币贷款减少1000亿元，M2同比增长7.1%。 美国10月PPI同比升6.5%，创近四年最大升幅。 美国财长贝森特：债券拍卖强劲，美元买盘旺盛。 美联储三把手“放鹰”：通胀仍过高，需采取行动使通胀及时回到2%。 美国芝加哥联储主席Goolsbee：通胀是广泛的，且朝着错误的方向发展。 IEA月报：全球石油市场转向供应过剩，波斯湾石油出口恢复至战前逾七成。 中东原油“全面夺回”亚洲市场，美国至亚洲油轮运价从高点跌61%。 英伟达新掌门会给AI融资踩刹车？她曾将2500亿美元数据中心担保砍半，被黄仁勋嘲讽“只会做财务”，
text_en: China's new social financing in October was 1.15 trillion yuan, RMB loans decreased by 100 billion yuan, and M2 rose 7.1% year on year. US October PPI rose 6.5% year on year, the largest increase in nearly four years. US Treasury Secretary Bessent: bond auctions are strong, with robust dollar buying. The Fed's No. 3 official turned hawkish: inflation is still too high, and action is needed to bring inflation back to 2% in a timely manner. Chicago Fed President Goolsbee: inflation is broad and moving in the wrong direction. IEA monthly report: the global oil market is turning to oversupply, and Persian Gulf oil exports have recovered to more than 70% of pre-war levels. Middle East crude has "fully recaptured" the Asian market, and US tanker freight rates to Asia have fallen 61% from their peak. Will Nvidia's new chief put the brakes on AI financing? She once halved a $250 billion data center guarantee and was mocked by Jensen Huang as "only good at finance."
